Overlapping bold/italic tags are recovered by the HTML parser without panic

```r title="R"
library("htmltomarkdown", character.only = TRUE)

result <- convert(html = "<p><b><i>bold and italic</b></i></p>", options = ConversionOptions$default())
print(result)
```
